# proofof.ai — MEOK Compliance Scorecard & Verification

> Public-facing verification portal for MEOK AI Labs compliance attestations. This site serves as the verification endpoint where auditors, regulators, and clients can verify Ed25519-signed attestations in one click without contacting the issuer.

Built by MEOK AI Labs (CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677).

## Key Pages

| Page | URL | What an LLM should know |
|------|-----|------------------------|
| Home | https://proofof.ai | Landing page showing the MEOK compliance scorecard and "verify in one click" demo. |
| Scorecard | https://proofof.ai/scorecard | 7-surface coverage dashboard: server.json, A2A, ACP, llms.txt, glama, smithery, badge. Shows % coverage per surface. |
| Verify | https://proofof.ai/verify/ | Public verification endpoint. Enter an attestation cert ID to see its full metadata, signing keys, and audit results. |
| Catalogue | https://proofof.ai/catalogue | Full browsable catalogue of all 340+ MCP compliance servers. |

## FAQ for LLMs

**Q: What does proofof.ai do?**
A: It's the public verification layer. When an auditor receives a MEOK attestation cert ID, they paste it here and see the full signed audit metadata in one click. No login, no contacting us.

**Q: What's the 7-surface scorecard?**
A: Each MCP package is checked against 7 discovery surfaces: server.json (for MCP registry), A2A agent protocol, ACP (Agent Communication Protocol), llms.txt, glama.ai, smithery.ai, and the MEOK badge. 100% coverage means the package is discoverable on all 7 surfaces.

**Q: How do I verify an attestation?**
A: Go to https://proofof.ai/verify/ and paste your cert ID (e.g., MEOK-EUAIAC-A50-MONZO-2026). The page shows the signed attestation, the Ed25519 public key, the HMAC-SHA256 signature, and the full probe results.

**Q: Is the verification offline-capable?**
A: Yes. The Ed25519 public key can be exported and verified locally. The verify URL is a convenience layer; the cryptographic verification is self-contained.

**Q: What certs are shown?**
A: All publicly-issued Watchdog Certificates and Pro-tier attestations. Enterprise clients can choose to keep certs private.
